historical_five_world_pack.rule: The environment-only five-world prompt pack cannot be selected as a scene source, product source, generation reference, or runtime gallery fallback for this production contract.

hero_dual_cast_four_sku_rule.scope: each collection's two hero-derived world moments together
hero_dual_cast_four_sku_rule.scene_composition: Both adults are naturally placed in each hero collection world. Across the two hero moments, their different collection-specific selections total four distinct exact SKUs at minimum and are assigned only by that collection's approved scene edit; all selected products share the physical floor, light, shadows, reflections, depth, occlusion, and real sightline or movement interaction.
hero_dual_cast_four_sku_rule.preorder_boundary: The third collection-preorder scene preserves its own exact CTA and does not count toward the two-hero-moment four-SKU requirement.
does_not_change: the continuous forward Scroll World order
hero_dual_cast_four_sku_rule.promotion_boundary: No rendered scene may claim this coverage from an off-scene authority image. Each approved hero-scene wearer/SKU allocation must have source, matte, detail, and native-integration evidence.

hero_derived_cta_anchor_rule.scope: all three declared CTA scenes in the Black Rose and Signature collections
hero_derived_cta_anchor_rule.rule: Each of the three scenes has one required primary hero-derived anchor in its exact approved form: font statue, scene backdrop, or protected graphic. The source object is hash-bound; no generated lettering, generic bridge, approximate logo, or interchangeable room is permitted.
hero_derived_cta_anchor_rule.black_rose_preorder_lock: BR-COMMERCE-3 preserves the Jersey Series intimate luxury-night salon with the exact Bay Bridge backdrop visible behind the collection; it may not become a generic night bridge or a disconnected catalog room.
hero_derived_cta_anchor_rule.preserved_scene_boundary: A local continuity reference never substitutes for local verification of the separately recorded preserved founder candidate or permission to alter/regenerate it.
hero_derived_cta_anchor_rule.promotion_boundary: This visual-continuity lock is additional to, not a substitute for, exact products, source/matte proof, native integration, independent visual QA, founder approval, wiring, or deployment gates.

love_hurts_enchanted_rose_story_rule.scope: all three declared Love Hurts CTA scenes
love_hurts_enchanted_rose_story_rule.rule: Every Love Hurts scene is a high-fashion product world around the same exact protected enchanted rose under glass. It remains visible, sharply legible, physically lit, and materially protected; generic hearts, flowers, substitute rose silhouettes, or decorative rose scatter are prohibited.
love_hurts_enchanted_rose_story_rule.beast_perspective: A protective, intimate watcher viewpoint from the Beast's side of the chamber: a low or shadow-edge editorial camera held on the guarded rose. Perspective and emotional grammar only; never a literal Beast character, costume, face, or imitation.
love_hurts_enchanted_rose_story_rule.high_fashion_rule: Use couture editorial negative space, sculptural stone, controlled candle/amber/crimson light, fabric texture, hardware detail, real body contact, and one coherent lens/light field. Product clarity and the enchanted rose remain premium focal authorities.
love_hurts_enchanted_rose_story_rule.promotion_boundary: This artistic/source lock does not clear exact cast, source/matte proof, native integration, independent visual QA, founder promotion, runtime wiring, or deployment.

scene_reference_index.rule: A provider request, prompt, candidate receipt, or scene candidate must name one exact scene_reference_id from this root-owned index and match its role, journey chapter, SKU cast, CTA, scene reference, and blocked/allowed state.

image.rule: Every approved on-model/product source is sent as a declared reference image only after the local generation receipt and source/matte gate pass. A techflat is never substituted for a physical worn source.

motion.camera_rule: One forward-only camera journey. Each leg starts from the previous reviewed final frame; do not use an end-image to force a disconnected portal transition.

provider_execution.authorization_scope: OPERATOR_PAUSED_COST_CONTROL. No paid call or remote upload is allowed until the exact founder-visible source pack and masks pass the local pre-submit gate and the founder explicitly resumes generation.

prohibitions: Black Rose Signature Hoodie is Black Rose, never Signature or SG

hero_language: protected enchanted rose/cathedral world — the enchanted rose is the non-negotiable focal object; preserved Vow Aisle cast is man: lh-004 + lh-002 and woman: lh-004 + lh-006

prohibitions: No generic San Francisco or Golden Gate environment
Keep the Bay Bridge blue story distinct from the Stay Golden purple story

native_integration_requirements: Every model group shares a floor plane, light direction, shadows, reflections, depth, occlusion, and sightline or movement interaction.
The product is the primary focal authority; the world is built around source camera geometry and never turns the model into a catalog cutout.

Each cast SKU has a current physical-product authority, approved same-pose on-model source, protected garment/accessory matte, full-size optical measurements, and a local receipt before any environment-provider upload; source-authority generation is the authorized upstream stage that creates the on-model source and matte evidence.
Every candidate needs an independent product-fidelity-native-review.v1 receipt and founder approval before runtime wiring.

v2_dual_cast_on_model_authority.coverage_requirement: Every V2 SKU must finish with one women-led and one men-led full-body on-model authority shot.
per_shot_requirements: current physical product authority inputs and SHA-256 hashes
source-stage candidate receipt, protected alpha matte, and local output hash
independent product-fidelity visual QA and founder approval before authority or scene use
no catalog-name text, invented labels, patches, construction, logos, lettering, or decorations
v2_dual_cast_on_model_authority.completion_rule: A candidate, rejected candidate, generic render, or unhash-bound legacy on-model file does not satisfy either cast slot. Each SKU needs two distinct approved cast records.

source_stage_execution.rule: Missing on-model authority images, multi-product same-pose authorities, and protected mattes are outputs of the source-authority production stage. Their absence must not block generation of quarantined source-stage candidates from verified physical product references.
required_before_source_stage_call: current root product SOT and per-SKU product hashes
hash-verified physical product and exact logo/art inputs
paid-candidate authorization and bounded request receipt
candidate quarantine with no runtime or scene promotion
created_after_source_candidate: founder approval or exact rejection/patch record
source_stage_execution.scene_environment_boundary: Approved source authority, protected matte, and independent/founder evidence remain mandatory before Higgsfield environment integration. This downstream scene gate does not prohibit the source-stage generation that creates the evidence.

br-004.silhouette_lock: The regular BLACK Rose Hoodie is the longer pullover: a hoodie dress on women and a longer hoodie on men.
br-004.branding_lock: One large monochrome Black Rose rose/cloud embroidery is centered above the pouch. The side body is plain.
br-004.visual_qa: Reject if BR-004 is shortened, gains side-body embroidery, receives Signature Edition construction or decoration, or loses its centered chest rose/cloud embroidery.

br-005.right_chest_lock: The right chest carries the exact product-specific molded silicone-cut form photographed on the physical BR-005. No standalone art is authorized; generic collection logos and data/brand-logos/three-rose-cluster.jpeg are prohibited substitutions.
br-005.hood_lining_lock: The hood is lined with the sublimated Black Rose rose design.
br-005.side_body_lock: The wearer's-left side body/viewer's-right torso carries the exact photographed longitudinal Black Rose rose/cloud embroidery from underarm to hem.

front-right-chest.surface: smooth clean-edged slightly raised rubber-like relief with no thread texture
front-right-chest.attachment: one applied cut-out unit seated flush to right-chest fabric; exact bonding chemistry remains unverified
front-right-chest.reject: thread embroidery, visible stitches, flat print, woven patch, multicolor applique, generic rose, or left-chest placement

wearer's-left side body / viewer-right t.material: white/grey embroidery thread on black polyester body fabric
wearer's-left side body / viewer-right t.surface: directional stitch texture and slight raised thread relief following side-body folds
wearer's-left side body / viewer-right t.attachment: thread penetrates the side-body fabric with no detachable patch border
wearer's-left side body / viewer-right t.reject: any sleeve, arm, forearm, shoulder, chest, or pocket placement; silicone, flat print, patch border, duplicate, text, or circular emblem

hood-inside / inner-hood-lining.material: sublimation dye within grey lining textile
hood-inside / inner-hood-lining.surface: lining weave remains visible with zero raised edge, pile, stitch relief, or patch thickness
hood-inside / inner-hood-lining.attachment: integral to the lining fibers and never an applied surface element
hood-inside / inner-hood-lining.reject: embroidery, patch, rubber relief, exterior pattern, solid-black lining, or substitute floral motif

br-005.visual_qa: Reject if any locked material is rendered as a different physical technique, if the BR-005 rose/cloud embroidery is moved, duplicated, relabelled, or otherwise differs from its photographed side-body treatment, or if surface/attachment/reject cues are not visibly satisfied; do not reuse a rejected candidate as a reference.

runtime_promotion_rule: The theme may render a collection gallery only when all three declared roles are FOUNDER_APPROVED_WIREABLE with hash-bound local assets, independent review receipts, founder approval references, exact casts, and exact CTA records. Otherwise it renders no scene media.
